description: teleport CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record): the stack this plugin's own tests run in. Installs teleport alone (it declares no dependencies: every edge that reaches another platform leaves that end open); the consumer flips self to editable so the checkout under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds teleport's own bundle (the /teleport page). Deliberately excluded: every other plugin, all credentials, anything that reaches the network.

plugins.note: Self, pinned at the bootstrap commit until the first tagged release; the consumer (plugin-ci, or `spawn --dev-plugins teleport`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4).

steps.note: teleport's own bundle: the /teleport page, its graph panel, projection, layout, scene searches and board panels.
